title: Bob changes the goal mid-thread: after an hour in person at the office was offered, he says "Make it 30 minutes and virtual." Re-propose 30-minute call times to the party; then the party accepts one: book it.
source: Synthetic (design section 6b), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-05; no capture exists. Calendar generated by scenarios/synthetic/calendar.ts from Bob's weekly pattern (titles, attendees and places in the captured fixtures' anonymized vocabulary), the scheduling policy is plan 39's (Winnie's config at ca6b6ee). The plan row is not updated by Bob's line (the bench has no steer intent): GOAL still reads an hour in person, and the change is only in BOB ON TELEGRAM, as it would be before decision 5's steer puts his words on the plan. The plan carries no holds (the bench has no hold release to exercise). An event's `capture` is the expected path's carry, not a recorded run: it is used only when a later event runs on its own.

thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us an hour next week? Come by the
office (Bay 4) and I'll show you the space. Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up an hour with you at the office (Bay 4). Here are times that work on his side:

- Mon, Nov 16, 12:15pm to 1:15pm ET
- Tue, Nov 17, 3:30pm to 4:30pm ET
- Thu, Nov 19, 2:15pm to 3:15pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three one-hour times at the office (Bay 4), Bob in cc.

events.trigger: Bob wrote about this plan on Telegram.

sent.summary: Offered three 30-minute times on a Meet link instead, Bob in cc.

constraints.what: Bob: make it 30 minutes and virtual

expect.basis: Bob's line changes the goal (decision 5: his words steer the plan). The one-hour offers no longer fit; she checks 30-minute times and proposes them to Quinn as a call, telling him the meeting changed.
expect.notes: V7 checks the 30-minute, virtual constraint from event 1 on (it is stated here); at this event only the outcome grades the proposal, which does not see durations. Condition A gets a 30-minute window check as a fact, because its base check uses the plan's 60 minutes.

events.trigger: Quinn Ashdown replied on the thread.

expect.basis: The accept rule: the accept-first persona says yes to the earliest time of her latest proposal; record it, book it, tell Bob it is behind a card. V7: the booking is 30 minutes and its why names no in-person venue.
